jp_anime.label: 2D 일본 애니
jp_anime.style_clause_current: Carry how the style reference draws figures. Any figures have slender naturalistic animated proportions, about seven and a half heads tall, with long limbs and small refined hands; tall almond eyes with a thick dark upper lash line drawn as one solid band, a dark iris carrying one small bright highlight and a lighter lower half, and no hard eyeliner beyond the lash band; a tiny sharp nose indicated by a short stroke and a small simply drawn mouth; hair is drawn as a few large clumps breaking into pointed strand tips; skin and cloth are cel shaded with one soft-edged shadow tone in a cool violet-blue, and shapes are held by thin colored outlines rather than heavy black ink.

facets.probe_anchors: Colored fine outlines of one weight, about 0.1% of image width: #18282d on objects, dark green on plants, brown grey on skin, hair in a darker tint of its own color; no lines on shadow edges; interior lines for seams and folds, no hatching. Hard cel shadows, warm cream lights, cool blue grey darks: curved planes on spheres, wedges on cloth; gradients only on lit sphere sides, walls and wood. Metal shows curved vertical reflection bands, glass thin arcs; thin painterly grain stays inside cels. Figures are about 8.4 heads tall, torso about 30% of height, lower legs about twice the thighs; anime faces with two iris tones, one catchlight, small nose, narrow pointed chin. In daylight, mean luminance about 56%, near-black about 4%, not a dark image; accent orange #f7a327 ≤ 3%, rounded organic surfaces; planar single tone cast shadows. Detail budget: dense, about 34 garment lines and 14 hair strand lines per figure, no decorative marks.
facets.figure: The figure combines an anime style face with enlarged eyes, a reduced nose and a thin narrowing jaw line, set on an anime body with a small head, narrow shoulders, a slightly compressed torso and lengthened lower legs. It is drawn as digital colored line art and cel coloring with a thin painterly surface grain, with high density eyes, thin colored lines and large cel planes whose grain stays lower in contrast and smoother than on still-life objects. Figures are about 8.4 heads tall, measured to the top of the hair or hat, so keep the skull itself small, measured from the top of the skull rather than the hair, with a head to torso ratio of about 1 to 2.5. Measured on the standing height from the ground up: the knee (top of the lower leg, shoe included) is at about 36% of the height, the crotch at about 54%, and the head from chin to skull top is about 12% of the height; draw the knee and the crotch at these heights, not higher, and the head at this size. The torso is a slightly compressed torso about 30% of the height, and the legs, soles included, are about 54% of the height. The lower leg is stretched lower legs about twice as long as the thigh, while the forearm and upper arm are about equal. The whole arm is about 38% of the height, so the fingertips reach mid thigh. The shoulder joints sit about 1.6 skull widths apart. The upper arm is about a third of the head width and the wrist about a fifth, and the limbs taper gently, with garments narrowing from thigh to ankle. The skull is round and narrows along the cheeks to a small curved chin. The eyes have a neutral corner tilt of about 3 degrees and a normal lid opening, with the upper lid covering about the top 15% of the iris. They are horizontally long almonds about 1.7 times as wide as tall, about 29% of the face width, centred slightly below the middle of the head, and their pointed outer corners extend the upper lid band into a short wedge. They are high density eyes rendered as two iris tones, darker above and lighter below, with a thin dark iris rim and one pupil plane darker than the iris. The iris is about 45% of the eye width and cut at the top by the lid, with no ring texture, no radial texture, no multiple reflections and no lower reflection crescent. Each eye has one small vertical oval catchlight in the upper iris, slightly to the screen left, about a fifth of the iris width, with no secondary catchlights and no glow. Two outer lash clumps are fused into a thick upper lid band about 0.2% of image width that tapers to a point outward, and there are no separate lower lashes. The lower lid is only a short, faint, broken line about 0.05% of image width, with no full dark rim and no tear duct mark. The eye outlines use the same dark colored line as the style, with the upper band the darkest. The sclera is yellowish white at both sides, with a faint shadow under the upper lid. Brows are thin gentle arcs filled as shapes with tapered ends, in a dark tone close to their own color, and are hidden where hair overlaps them. The nose is a short vertical line with a small side shadow and no realistic nostrils. The mouth is a short horizontal stroke, never lips closed by a heavy outline. Hands have separated fingers with thin joint lines and no tendons or detailed nails. Elbows get a short line and wrists a gentle curve, with no muscle hatching. Shoes are rounded wedges about 0.86 head long and oversized about 0.73 head tall, with thin soles about a ninth of the shoe height and about 5 construction lines each, and there is no extreme enlargement of hands or feet. Hair is built from long curved clumps that gather into thin pointed tips: about 7 large clumps holding about 14 low-contrast strand lines, with about 8 outer points, the longest about a sixth of the face height. Hair highlights are short, broken, angular patches shaped like wedges and trapezoids that follow the flow at low contrast, and the hair outline is a darker tint of its own color; hairstyle and color follow the content. Clothing is matte color planes in which large fold shading dominates small texture, with long fold lines paired with wedge-shaped shadow planes. Garments follow the body with some ease, bend gently at sleeve ends and knees, and carry no added ornaments. Poses tend to be relaxed and upright, with the weight between both feet, shoulders and hips nearly level, and a straight central axis without a strong S-curve. Arms tend to hang almost straight, leaving small gaps beside the torso and a gap between the legs. Joints are expressed with restraint and no foreshortening exaggeration; when the scene specifies an action, the action comes first and this rhythm is applied to it. Expressions are made with the brow arcs, the lid opening and the mouth corners, with no comic expression marks. Skin keeps the character's own color with low-saturation shadow planes in about two cel steps, a base plus an under-chin shadow. It stays matte, with only a light plane near the nose, no glossy highlights, a faint broad cheek color change, no diagonal blush marks and no pores. Detail budget: dense — each figure, regardless of its size on screen, carries about 34 structural garment lines (about 8 on the top, 16 on the bottoms and 10 on the shoes) plus about 20 repeated lines on functional eyelets and laces, tops in three value steps, hair as described with about 14 strand lines, each eye about eight elements in total, no decorative marks and no speed lines. Keep every proportion close to the stated values; do not exaggerate beyond them.
facets.priority: Priority order: thin colored lines, hard-edged cel shadows → metal reflection bands, thin grain → slightly compressed torso, stretched lower legs → large eyes, small nose, narrow pointed chin
facets.negative: Avoid chibi anime, glossy game illustration, semi-realistic portraiture, flat vector cartoon, moire, sensor noise, compression halos, photographic glare, thick black outlines, uniform plastic gloss, giant shoes, extreme body compression, copied still-life arrangement, copied two-person lineup, copied outfits, copied hairstyles, bokeh particle fields, intricate radial irises, wet floor reflections, ornamental filigree, readable text, logos, watermarks, signatures.
facets.capsule: Digital cel shaded illustration: colored fine line art over flat cels with a thin painterly grain on walls, wood and matte forms. Detail budget: dense, about 34 garment lines per figure, no decorative marks.
facets.scene: Six still-life objects (a sphere, a metal cup, a glass, a cloth, a fruit and a potted plant) sit on a table by a window, seen slightly from above, with the front cloth partly overlapping the plant behind; there are no people. Separately, two casually dressed people stand side by side before a plain backdrop, seen frontally head to toe with neutral faces.

height-percent line: right after the heads-tall sentence, one deterministic sentence 'Measured on the standing height from the ground up: the knee … at about N% of the height, the crotch at about N%, and the head … about N% …; draw the knee and the crotch at these heights, not higher, and the head at this size.' computed from the filled proportions (head % = 100 / heads, crotch % = leg share, knee % = leg share × r/(1+r) with r = lower leg : thigh; the knee clause is omitted when the segment ratio is a proxy)

facets.probe_anchors: No outlines and no secondary contour; interior structure appears as soft shading seams about 0.1 to 0.2% of image width. Shading is lineless and continuous, no tone steps, no hatching; one connected soft shadow per form; soft contact shadows darkest at contact, never separate ellipses. In daylight scenes mean luminance about 64%, near-black about 2%, mean saturation about 16%; objects keep own colors over warm neutral #efede9; accent #aaa34d ≤ 0.65% on one small surface. facets.figure: The figure has a cartoon face with round enlarged eyes, a small tidy nose and a rounded chin. It sits on a semi-realistic body whose only stretch is in the lower legs. Everything is rendered as 3D animation, with no outline strokes, curved volume shading, and diffusion and reflection that differ by material. The figure is about 7.4 heads tall, with the head measured to the top of the skull under the hair rather than to the top of the hair, measured to the top of the hair or hat, so keep the skull itself small. Measured on the standing height from the ground up: the knee (top of the lower leg, shoe included) is at about 29% of the height, the crotch at about 47%, and the head from chin to skull top is about 14% of the height; draw the knee and the crotch at these heights, not higher, and the head at this size. Head to torso is about 1 to 2.55. The torso, from the shoulder line to the crotch, is about 34% of the height, and the legs are about 47% of the height including the soles. The lower leg from knee to sole is slightly stretched lower legs about 1.63 times the thigh, while the upper arm and forearm are about equal in length. The arms are about 39% of the height, so hanging fingertips reach the upper thigh just below the crotch. Shoulders span about 2.2 skull widths. Hands are about 0.73 face heights long. Shoes seen from the side are slightly oversized about 0.9 head lengths long and 0.56 head lengths high, with rounded toes, a gentle wedge and a front sole about 14% of the shoe height. Limbs are round in section with a gentle taper: the upper arm is about 0.37 face widths thick, the forearm about 0.30, and the legs narrow steadily toward the ankle. Elbows, wrists and knees are soft bends without muscle bundles or joint lines. Clear gaps separate each arm from the torso, about a tenth of a head height wide, and the legs stand about half a head height apart. The head is rounded on top and narrows gently to a rounded chin. The eyes have a neutral, nearly level corner tilt. They are opened wide, so the upper lid covers only about a tenth of the iris. They are horizontally long at about 1.7 to 1 and round in form, with short rounded corners and no trailing tail line. Each eye is about 24% of the face width, centered near the middle of the head height. Eye treatment is standard: a continuous iris gradient, darker above and lighter below, with a thin dark rim and a distinct pupil. There is no separate lower reflection, and the iris fills about 60% of the eye width. There is one small oval catchlight toward the upper left at about a fifth of the iris height, in the same direction in both eyes, with no secondary catchlight and no glow. The white shows at the sides, with a faint shadow under the upper lid. Lashes are fused into the upper lid band, with no individual lashes. The upper lid is a thin shading line about 0.1% of image width, strongest in the middle and tapering at the ends. There is no lower lid line, and the lid shading is a brown to reddish brown local tone. Eyebrows are wide curved masses with fine texture, tapering at the ends and never drawn over the hair. The nose is a small solid form whose rounded tip and nostrils are separated only by shading. The mouth is a short thin shading gap with faint lip volume and no dark rim. Hands have separated fingers, rounded backs and tapering fingertips. Hair is built from large curved clumps that start round at the root and narrow toward short tips. It carries surface strand texture and soft gradient highlights that follow each clump, with no separate hair lines and no outline. A short hairstyle like the sample has about 8 large clumps and about 8 short tufts along its outline, but the hairstyle itself sets the count. Garments show fine fiber texture and follow the body in soft volumes with gentle gravity sag. Functional ties keep their form, and no decoration is added. Poses tend toward a stable upright stance with level shoulders and hips and the weight centered between both feet. The line from head to pelvis stays nearly straight, and relaxed limbs hang almost straight, leaving clear gaps between the limbs. There is no exaggerated foreshortening, and the acting is neutral. When the scene specifies an action, the action comes first and this rhythm is applied to it. Expressions are made with the gentle curve of the brows, the lid opening, the mouth corners and the curve of the cheeks, with no cartoon emotion symbols. Skin keeps its own surface color with continuous curved shading and soft, borderless blush on the cheeks and ears. It has a near-matte, light satin sheen with a small soft highlight on the nose tip, and no cel boundaries, no pores and no plastic gloss. Detail budget: extreme. Each figure carries about 32 structural lines regardless of its size on screen: about 13 on the top, 13 on the bottom and 6 on the shoes. These are drawn as soft shading seams, plus fine vertical ribs about 0.3% of image width apart on knit hems. Hair is large clumps with strand texture, and the eyes carry five shading elements. There is no hatching and no added decoration. Small distant figures keep face and garment volume without forcing every eye element. Keep every proportion close to the stated values; do not exaggerate beyond them.

facets_v3.figure: A realistic face with small natural eyes, a modeled nose and a natural jawline, on a realistic adult body, rendered as continuous photographic shading with skin and weave texture, no cel boundaries and no outlines on body, garments or hair; no period graphic markers. facets.figure: Realistic throughout, with standard eyes: a realistic adult face with a horizontally long eye opening, a dimensional nose and finely uneven skin, on a realistic adult body with no torso compression, rendered photographically with no outlines and shading attached to each material. Figures are about 7.7 heads tall, measured from the top of the skull rather than the hair. Measured on the standing height from the ground up: the knee (top of the lower leg, shoe included) is at about 25% of the height, the crotch at about 43%, and the head from chin to skull top is about 13% of the height; draw the knee and the crotch at these heights, not higher, and the head at this size. Measured to the top of the hair or hat, so keep the skull itself small. Head to torso is about 1 to 3, and the torso from shoulder line to crotch is about 39% of the height. The legs from crotch to sole, including shoes, are about 43% of the height. The arm from shoulder to fingertip is about 40% of the height and reaches the upper thigh, with the forearm about 0.77 of the upper arm. The lower leg is, with slightly stretched lower legs, about 1.5 times the thigh, but that ratio was taken over clothing and shoes and is not a stretch to exaggerate. The shoulders are about 2.3 head widths, and the limbs are about a third of a head width thick, tapering anatomically rather than as even tubes; a trouser leg narrows from about 134 to 110 to 99 units from thigh to knee to ankle. Hands are about 0.69 face heights long. Shoes have rounded dimensional toes and thin soles, are about 0.6 head tall in front view, and the sole is about a tenth of the shoe height. The eyes come next. Their outer corners tilt very slightly upward, about 3 degrees, and the lids sit at an ordinary opening, with the upper lid covering about the top fifth of the iris and narrow side whites visible. They are almond eyes about three times as wide as tall, each about a fifth of the face width, centred on the head's midline. These are standard eyes rendered in continuous shading: a soft two-zone iris, darker above and lighter below, with a thin dark rim and a soft-edged pupil. There is one small round catchlight in the upper iris, about a seventh of the iris width, with no secondary catchlight and no glow. Lashes are fused into the upper lid edge, with no separate lash strands. The upper lid edge is a thin soft arc about 0.1% of image width, the lower lid line is faint and broken, and the outer corners meet in a point without wing lines. Eye contours are brown and russet shading, never black ink, and the whites are shaded warm grey rather than pure white. Brows are narrow soft areas of hair texture, not single strokes. The face narrows gently from cheek to chin, and the nose and lips are modelled in continuous shading rather than reduced to symbols. Hands have separated fingers, with knuckles and the back of the hand modelled in shading, never mitten shapes. Hair is one connected mass wrapping the round skull, with fine low-contrast texture, about 4 larger tips separating at the outline, softly fading edges and scattered low-contrast sheen along the texture. It has no graphic highlight band and no countable strand lines, and its colour and length follow the character. Clothes hang naturally over the body with woven fiber texture and matte surfaces. Poses tend toward natural, restrained upright stances: shoulders and hips are level, the weight is centred between the feet and the body follows a straight vertical rhythm. Limbs are nearly straight, with slim gaps between arms and torso and a wider gap between the legs. Hands and feet are not foreshortened toward the camera, and there is no theatrical gesture. When the scene specifies an action, the action comes first and this rhythm is applied to it, keeping natural weight and anatomical joints. Expressions are made with the eye region (lid opening and brow shape) and the mouth region (lips, mouth corners and cheek volume), never with cartoon emotion marks. Skin keeps its own tone under warm light, with continuous shading and a weak diffuse sheen on forehead and nose. Lips and cheeks get low-contrast colour shifts, with no blush lines, no cel steps and no plastic gloss. Detail budget: extreme — about 34 structural garment boundaries per figure regardless of its size on screen (about 14 on the top, 14 on the trousers and 6 on the shoes), all shown as shading. Add fine repeated weave ridges about 5 px apart at 2048 px width, such as about 10 ridges across a cuff. Hair stays one mass with about 4 tips, and each eye has about 6 separated elements. There are no attached ornaments, no hatching and no decorative marks. Keep every proportion close to the stated values; do not exaggerate beyond them.

They are almond eyes about three times as wide as tall, each about a fifth of the face width, centred on the head's midline. There is one small round catchlight in the upper iris, about a seventh of the iris width, with no secondary catchlight and no glow. Lashes are fused into the upper lid edge, with no separate lash strands. The upper lid edge is a thin soft arc about 0.1% of image width, the lower lid line is faint and broken, and the outer corners meet in a point without wing lines. Eye contours are brown and russet shading, never black ink, and the whites are shaded warm grey rather than pure white. Brows are narrow soft areas of hair texture, not single strokes. The face narrows gently from cheek to chin, and the nose and lips are modelled in continuous shading rather than reduced to symbols. Hands have separated fingers, with knuckles and the back of the hand modelled in shading, never mitten shapes. Hair is one connected mass wrapping the round skull, with fine low-contrast texture, about 4 larger tips separating at the outline, softly fading edges and scattered low-contrast sheen along the texture. It has no graphic highlight band and no countable strand lines, and its colour and length follow the character. Clothes hang naturally over the body with woven fiber texture and matte surfaces. Poses tend toward natural, restrained upright stances: shoulders and hips are level, the weight is centred between the feet and the body follows a straight vertical rhythm. Limbs are nearly straight, with slim gaps between arms and torso and a wider gap between the legs. Hands and feet are not foreshortened toward the camera, and there is no theatrical gesture. Skin keeps its own tone under warm light, with continuous shading and a weak diffuse sheen on forehead and nose. There are no attached ornaments, no hatching and no decorative marks.

The eyes are horizontal almonds about 2.2 times as wide as tall, with pointed corners; each is about a fifth of the face width and set at about the middle of the head height. Each eye shows one visible iris tone with a soft edged pupil, and the iris is about half the eye width. There is one small round catchlight at the upper center, about a fifth of the iris width, with no secondary catchlights and no glow. The sclera is a dimmed grey, shaded under the upper lid, never pure white. Lashes merge into a thin dark upper lid boundary about 0.1% of image width (2 px at 2048 px width), and the lower lid is a broken low contrast edge. There is no ink outline colour: eye edges are darker, low saturation tones of the surrounding skin. Brows are hair textured masses in soft shading. The nose is modeled by continuous shading with small dark nostrils, and the lips are thin volumes with contact shadow, never a single dark line. Hands show separated fingers of differing length with knuckles in soft volume shading, never mittens. Hair is one large connected mass of overlapping curved bundles with a faint sheen running along them. Its soft edge breaks into about 12 small tips, each up to about a tenth of the face height, with about 8 separable strand lines and no triangular spikes. Clothing shows visible fiber grain, sits loosely over the body volume and folds gently at the joints, with folds only at overlaps and tension points. Where a knit is ribbed, its ribs sit about 0.2% of image width apart (about 4 px at 2048 px width). Poses tend to stand upright and balanced, with the weight shared between both feet and the shoulders and hips nearly level. A straight vertical line runs from head through pelvis with no strong S curve, and the arms hang almost straight at the sides, leaving a narrow gap beside each hand and one between the legs. Gesture intensity stays quiet and low, with no exaggerated foreshortening. When the scene specifies an action, the action comes first and this rhythm is applied to it, keeping real body weight and joints. Expression is carried by brow curvature, lid opening and lip tension, with no comic emotion symbols. Skin keeps its own colour as low saturation continuous tone, diffuse and semi matte, with a small highlight only on the nose and faint warm shifts on the lips and parts of the face. It shows slight tonal unevenness, no blush circles, no hatching and no cel boundaries, and it is never plastic or porcelain smooth. Detail budget: medium — per figure, regardless of its size on screen, there are about 24 tonal garment boundaries (about 12 structural and 12 folds) plus about 4 on each shoe. lite.probe_anchors: Digital transparent watercolor wash with bare paper, in linear perspective from a low overhead viewpoint. No outlines and no interior lines, forms separate by color shifts. Painterly gradient fill, about four to five value steps, soft form shadows as gentle crescents on one or two planes, soft contact cast shadows. Palette: cream #d8cdb6 primary, tan #b99a70 secondary, red-orange #d9482f accent ≤ 5%, low to medium saturation, warm gray-brown darks. Round smooth forms, irregular breaks only in cloth and leaves. Cold-press paper grain with pigment pooling, no pattern fills. Soft blurred background washes, unless the scene specifies its own backdrop. Detail budget: level 3, about six main objects.
lite.figure: No figure sample exists, so any figure takes its proportions, pose and hair from the scene's content, and the style supplies only the wash treatment. Face, body and rendering all follow the transparent watercolor still-life treatment. Forms come from wash planes and value differences, without outlines or strand lines. Eyes, nose and mouth are minimal dots or pale color stains. Clothing keeps its type and structure but is simplified into large lineless wash planes. Skin is a warm, low-saturation wash. When the scene specifies an action, the action comes first.
lite.priority: Priority order: transparent watercolor wash → lineless color-edge forms → bare paper grain → warm muted palette → single small red accent.
lite.negative: Avoid gouache, ink-and-wash line art, photorealistic still life, black outlines, flat cel fills, hard drop shadows, extra hatching, fine leaf veins, extra props, photographic noise, readable text or logos, no speed lines.
